saw_lines: Nobody buys a home skin laser on a hunch. They check the price, the delivery and the results first.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where shipping, proof and price either get answered or the buyer leaves.
Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Put the delivery answer in the first line of every new buyer ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site answers how it ships, but 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer weighing a costly device has no reason to act. Open new buyer ads with one plain line on delivery and returns.
None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so claims about results read as promises. Pick one number you can defend, like a review count or units shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
9 of your 30 copy ads open on the same Helena line, so a buyer who scrolls past it sees nothing new. Test two new openers against it, one on the daily routine and one on the price of a home device.
0 of 30 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to buy today. Put one reason to act in the first line of new buyer ads, such as a first order offer or a laser and skincare bundle.

ads_1: Delivery answer, proof number and first order offer lead new creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X
